provisions.body:
Regulations National Organization (NO) Requirements/guidelines and agreement

National Organization (NO) Requirements and guidelines

This document outlines the requirements and procedures for becoming an official National Organization (NO) within Buhurt International (BI). All stipulations must be met for a successful affiliation with our organisation.

provisions.title: Requirements to Form/Become a NO
Board Structure: We recommend minimal 2 people in the board of the NO + 1 required
provisions.body: National representative, example below.

provisions.title: President
Board member / Chairman / Chairwoman
(optional) Treasurer
(optional) National Representative (NR)
provisions.body: Additional Notes Minimum Board Members: The board must consist of more than one member, and it is recommended to have at least three members. This ensures a diverse set of perspectives and aids in internal decision-making through voting.

provisions.title: National Representative (NR) is a person who is actively engaged in BI and connected to
provisions.body: the NO. This person does not have to be a board member, but it's recommended.
Membership (minimum) requirement:

provisions.title: The NO must have a minimum of 15 (fifteen) documented members
provisions.body: Important: All competitors and staff are free to compete or work at any event or organisation without restriction or repercussion.

provisions.title: Online Presence: The NO is required to maintain a website/social media presence to
provisions.body: serve as a contact point for interested individuals.

provisions.title: Validation: Documentation proving the NO's approval/registration within the represented
provisions.body: country, including but not limited to:

provisions.title: Legislative documentation: Copy of NO constitution and application for
provisions.body: recognition with the local legislature.

provisions.title: Non-Profit Recognition Documentation: Copy of documentation proving NO's
provisions.body: recognition as a non-profit/charitable organisation.

provisions.title: Exception Documentation: If gaining legal status is not possible, submission of
provisions.body: documentation and correspondence explaining the circumstances for BI review.

provisions.title: Representation: The NO is mandated to represent every individual living inside its country
provisions.body: or region.

provisions.title: Inclusivity: Allowing every individual to join the NO any refusal requires
provisions.body: documented justification for the BI judiciary committee's review.

provisions.title: Non-discrimination: No member can be rejected based on ethnicity, sexual
provisions.body: preference, religion, mental or physical disabilities.
Registry: Maintain a record of the member list for cross-referencing purposes by BI.

provisions.title: Ratification: All member NO’s will vote to ratify your membership
Communication and Voting
Centralized Communication Policy: Official communication will be exclusively conducted
provisions.body: through the BI website/forum, where all necessary documentation for NOs will be published.

provisions.title: Delegated Documentation and Reporting: NOs are responsible for sharing provided
provisions.body: documentation with their members, collecting feedback, conducting votes, and reporting the results back to BI professionally.
Voting: All votes must be collected and presented to BI systematically.
Mutual respect: All NOs will recognize and respect each other's membership rosters.

provisions.title: Regions and Countries
Regional Cooperation: A Region contains two (2) countries or more that combine their
provisions.body: resources to set up 1 (one) national organisation.

provisions.title: Removal of National Organization (NO)
Discretionary removal: BI reserves the right to remove a NO from its role under specific
provisions.body: circumstances.
Grounds for Removal:
Non-Compliance: Failure to adhere to the outlined requirements and guidelines.

provisions.title: Misconduct: Engagement in discriminatory practices, unfair membership
provisions.body: rejections, or unethical behavior.

provisions.title: Failure to communicate: Inability or unwillingness to maintain proper
provisions.body: communication channels with BI
Due Process:
Prior Notification: BI will provide written notification outlining specific issues, allowing the NO an opportunity to rectify the situation.

provisions.title: Review and Appeal: The NO will have the right to present their case before a fair
provisions.body: and thorough review by BI.

provisions.title: Referendum: There will be a vote amongst all other NO on the removal based
provisions.body: upon arguments provided by BI and defence provided by the NO. An absolute majority will result in removal of the NO.

provisions.title: Decision: NO will be communicated in writing, along with the reasons, and will
provisions.body: be final and effective immediately.
Transition of Responsibilities:

provisions.title: Removal: In the event of removal, BI will specify steps for the transition of
provisions.body: responsibilities, including the transfer of member records.

provisions.title: Intervention: BI may facilitate the appointment of an interim governing body or
provisions.body: take other necessary measures.
Amendment of Guidelines:

provisions.title: Amendment: BI reserves the right to amend guidelines at its discretion, with
provisions.body: timely communication to all NOs.

provisions.title: Buhurt International (BI) will be providing

provisions.body: Certifications marshals, Authenticity and Tournament Directors(Event Team).

provisions.title: Regulations and standards by the Marshals, Authenticity, and Tournament Directors (with
provisions.body: regular development).
International ranking Tournament tracking and ranking.
Platform for Competitors/Teams to be tracked and recognized.

provisions.title: Structure for Competitors/Teams “to be regulated and standardized”

provisions.body: Annual General Assembly (AGM) with election and voting process.

provisions.title: Disciplinary Committee organisation for handling violations of the Code of Conduct (CoC)
provisions.body: and Regulations

provisions.title: Membership (season license) for competitors

provisions.body: All BI competitors must be members of their National Organization.

provisions.title: Membership Fee

provisions.body: Membership fee is set by the AGM.
BI competitors will pay individually to BI.
NO will identify them as members of NO to BI.

The set fee is for 1 season licence. (Start date: Jan 15 / End date: Dec 15).

By entering an agreement with Buhurt International, all NOs acknowledge and accept BI's authority to enforce these guidelines and take appropriate action when necessary.
